questions.q: Children need much of guidance in how to use the internet wisely and efficiently.
questions.s: (c) Explanation:- 'Much' ka use quantity show karne generally negative ya interrogative me kiya jata hai. eg. There was too much traffic today. Yhan positive me baat karni hai aur 'of' preposition bhi ek hint hai ki 'a lot of ' ka use hoga.

questions.q: The less you are confused while taking / these tests, the less errors / you will make.
o: The less you are confused while taking
questions.s: Explanation:- Use fewer errors in place of less errors. kyunki 'errors' noun countable hai aur countable ke sath little nahi few adjective ki degree ka use hota hai.
